instructions_to_main_agent: Use LIGHT theme with Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast). Ensure high functionality and clarity.
Typography: Import and use 'Outfit' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Do NOT use Inter.
Dashboard layout: Apply a 'Control Room' grid approach with flat bordered cards, maximizing space utility. Avoid heavy glassmorphism.
Status Indicators: strictly use the specified colors for Pending (amber), In Progress (blue), and Resolved (emerald) as colored pills.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='complaint-submit-btn', data-testid='status-filter-pending').
The Public Tracking page should use a clean, asymmetric bento or split layout leveraging the 'hero_tracking' image.
Keep standard Shadcn components but override their styles to match the flat, high-contrast, 'border-slate-200 rounded-md' aesthetic.
